ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species receives energy from every level of the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image shows a food web. At the bottom, producers can be seen, including berries and flowers, grasses, seeds; in the middle there are consumers such as deer, grouse, chipmunk, marmot; at higher levels there are grizzly bear and red-tailed hawk. The lower left corner is labeled “decomposers and detritivores”. The red arrows indicate energy flow, and in the image the energy paths from different food-chain levels can ultimately all point to the decomposers and detritivores in the lower left corner. Then reason: The question asks which species or group receives energy from every level of the food chain. Decomposers use the remains or waste of organisms at all levels, so they can obtain energy from producers, consumers, higher-level predators, and other levels. The decomposers and detritivores in the lower left corner of the image is exactly this energy-gathering position, so the answer is decomposers.
